_readme: Every tunable number lives here. Coordinates are fractions of the frame (0-1). Change a value, push, reinstall; no Swift changes needed.

analysis._readme: How often the live feed is analyzed. Fast = people, faces, objects. Slow = scene labels, horizon, saliency, face landmarks.

detection._readme: Detection only DESCRIBES the frame; it never picks the photo type. A new subject category must be proposed this many ticks in a row (12 ticks = 1 s) before it replaces the current one. categoryMinConfidence = minimum detector confidence for an object (food or other) to decide the category; scene labels use their own thresholds below.
detection._people: A person counts as the subject if their box covers this much of the frame, or a face is found.
detection._framing: Close-up (headshot framing) needs a big face AND shoulders near the bottom edge (or below it). Otherwise half body / full body.
detection._mirror: Mirror cue: a phone on the person's body, near their head.
detection._building: Sanity checks: a building needs the scene label AND distance (focus far, not macro, no big close object) AND strong vertical lines. Outdoor labels add confidence. lensPosition is 0 (closest focus) to 1 (farthest); calibrate buildingMinLensPosition from the debug overlay's 'Distance' row.
detection._distance: Rough distance for people from face size: an adult face is about this wide.
detection._lighting: Descriptors shown in the debug overlay and used by coaching.

naming._readme: Naming chain for objects, all on the phone: (1) live detector; (2) Apple's classifier on a crop of just the object when the detector is unsure; (3) a fingerprint match against names you or Claude gave before (your corrections win). Label shows plainly at >= confidentShow, with '?' at >= mediumShow. memoryMatchDistance: how similar a fingerprint must be (smaller = stricter; the debug log shows distances).

auto._readme: M3 automatic camera settings. Lens: a new lens must be wanted for lensHoldSeconds before switching, and switches are at least lensMinIntervalSeconds apart; tapping a lens button or pinching turns auto-lens off (badge). Exposure: bias in EV. Low light: enters when ISO >= lowLightEnterISO or brightness < lowLightEnterBrightness, leaves below the exit values. Night merge (burst + align + average) when ISO >= nightMergeISO and the phone is steady (shake < steadyShake). Motion: frame change above fastShutterMotion caps the shutter at fastShutterSeconds. White balance: casts beyond castThreshold (with a face) get a gentle correction.

guide._readme: Step stability. Every check value is smoothed (smoothing = how much each new reading counts, 0-1; lower = steadier). A step completes when its value stays inside its tight band (playbook min/max) for holdSeconds, then it is LATCHED: it only becomes undone if the value stays outside the wide band (playbook undoMin/undoMax, or the tight band widened by undoWiden x its width each side, at least undoMinMargin) for undoSeconds. maxSteps: a shot never shows more than this many steps.

stages._readme: Stage machine: SEARCHING -> LOCKED -> GUIDING -> READY -> REVIEW. Goes back only when you cancel, the subject is lost for lostSubjectSeconds, or (only while LOCKED) the phone turns to a new scene: turned more than newSceneTurnDegrees within a second AND the picture changed more than newSceneFrameChange. Auto-start: guiding starts autoStartDelaySeconds after a lock with the best card pre-selected (turn off in Settings).

people._readme: Person types (kid, teen, man, woman, older man, older woman) from the on-device model. Below personTypeMinConfidence the label is just 'person'. Smoothing: how much each new reading counts (0-1). A face gone this long is forgotten (with its correction).

ai._readme: 'Identify with AI' (only when you tap it). Offered when a tapped object is below identifyBelowConfidence, or nothing was detected where you tapped. The image sent is a crop around the object, at most maxImageDimension pixels.

subject._readme: Tap-to-select: the tapped person/object is followed by overlap between frames; released if it's gone this long.
